adjudication.rationale:
The diff explicitly changes calendar references/destination calendars to multi-element arrays, but some cleanup paths still only operate on a single calendar reference.

- In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the merge-delete path when `newBookingId` is set still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (single match). If a booking now has multiple `_calendar` references (as enabled by the multi-destination changes), only the first will be deleted, leaving stale events.

- In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, the recurring-cancel branch iterates updated bookings and does `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` (single match) when deleting, so for bookings with multiple calendar references only one gets deleted per updated booking.

These are correctness defects consistent with the refactor to multi-calendar support and can leave stale events in other hosts’ calendars.
